result.Method of Attack: Extracts sensitive information from user systems using persistence techniques, browser data extraction, and token harvesting; employs obfuscated code and evasion techniques to detect debugging or analysis environments and self-terminate if detected; fetches and runs malicious code from a remote URL; extracts browser login credentials, cookies, web history, and Discord authentication tokens, decrypts and validates tokens before exfiltration
result.Impacted Systems: All platforms where PyPI packages can be installed; Any individuals or institutions that have these malicious packages installed
result.Attack Vector: Malicious PyPI package installation and execution; Remote code fetched and executed from URL; Supply chain attack via PyPI
